phases.title: Review reference circuit
phases.outcome: Environment, constraints and first executable SPICE proof.
phases.gate: ngspice executable detected; one low-pass test netlist generates a valid AC output, or failure logged with installation instructions.

tasks.title: Agree boundaries
tasks.action: Choose supported platform, source amplitude/load assumptions, component ranges and compute budget; review design safety.
tasks.acceptance: No unsupported circuits or implicit idealizations in requirements.
tasks.evidence: Project owner explicitly stated on 2026-11-19: بازبینی کردم و Phase 1 را تأیید می‌کنم. Owner acceptance covers the documented ideal-source/load, continuous RC assumptions and circuit/reference results. See docs/DECISIONS.md. No separate peer/hardware signoff asserted.

tasks.title: Scaffold tested Python project
tasks.action: Create pyproject.toml, src package, pytest scaffolding, .gitignore, tooling docs and executable path detection.
tasks.deliverable: Installable local package and ngspice preflight command.
tasks.acceptance: pytest passes on deterministic tests even if ngspice missing; missing simulator is reported clearly.
tasks.evidence: Installable package built and installed locally; pytest unit tests pass; missing simulator preflight tested. See docs/DEVELOPMENT.md.

tasks.title: Run first SPICE smoke test
tasks.action: Generate allowed RC netlist in temp directory and call ngspice non-interactively with timeout.
tasks.deliverable: Test fixture plus captured AC sweep output.
tasks.acceptance: On installed ngspice, genuine exit 0 and numeric sweep; no fake output fallback.
tasks.evidence: ngspice-47 console exit 0; 601 real AC rows; evidence/lowpass-2026-11-18/{stdout.log,response.csv,report.json}.

tasks.title: Review reference circuit
tasks.action: Review RC low-pass schematic, correct ground, source and load assumptions with teammate.
tasks.deliverable: Signed-off idealized fixture and expected fc.
tasks.acceptance: Expected fc and assumptions independently confirmed.
tasks.evidence: Project owner explicitly stated on 2026-11-19: بازبینی کردم و Phase 1 را تأیید می‌کنم. Owner acceptance covers the documented ideal-source/load, continuous RC assumptions and circuit/reference results. See docs/DECISIONS.md. No separate peer/hardware signoff asserted.

phases.gateEvidence: Owner explicitly confirmed Phase 1 circuit/result review on 2026-11-19; automated evidence: 122 passing tests and eight genuine reference cases. See docs/DECISIONS.md. This is not Phase 2 or push authorization.

phases.title: Verify RC low/high-pass fixtures
phases.outcome: Typed specs, safe netlists and independently checked transfer functions.
phases.gate: RC cutoff and amplitude/phase checks pass analytical fixtures; invalid specs rejected.

tasks.title: Define typed circuit specifications
tasks.action: Define Pydantic models for RC type, cutoff, source/load, units, ranges and E-series policy; reject invalid.
tasks.acceptance: Invalid freq, nonpositive elements, unsupported topology and out-of-range values fail clearly.
tasks.evidence: Pydantic SI schemas, low/high-pass types, continuous-value policy, explicit ideal source/load and bounds/infeasibility/injection tests. Review fixes enforce at least two sweep samples and tolerance-aware target feasibility; 122 tests pass, including four genuine fixed-target CLI cases.

tasks.title: Implement ngspice adapter
tasks.action: Subprocess integration with allowlisted templates, timeout, logs, temp dirs, return codes, failure reports.
tasks.acceptance: No arbitrary command injection or unrestricted .include; proper failure on absent ngspice.
tasks.evidence: Real ngspice integration plus timeout, output-limit, absent binary, launch and nonzero-exit tests; full frequency grid and partial-search failures verified. Isolated test environment: 122 tests passed, including genuine two-sample sweeps and fixed-target low/high-pass CLI cases. See docs/DEVELOPMENT.md.

tasks.title: Extract AC metrics
tasks.action: Parse complex AC response, interpolation of −3 dB cutoff, gain/phase arrays.
tasks.acceptance: Measured cutoff agrees with analytic first-order RC within documented discretization tolerance.
tasks.evidence: Complex response and phase checked against analytic references. Additional eight real electrical review cases span four distinct cutoff scales per topology; all passed with max cutoff error 0.005891%. See docs/PHASE1_REVIEW.md and scripts/verify_phase1.py; owner review accepted on 2026-11-19 (docs/DECISIONS.md).

tasks.title: Verify RC low/high-pass fixtures
tasks.action: Cross-check both topologies, source/load simplifications and expected phase behavior.
tasks.acceptance: At least 4 reference cases with analytical solutions and independently checked expectations.

phases.gateEvidence: Owner explicitly confirmed Phase 1 circuit/result review on 2026-11-19; automated evidence: 122 passing tests and eight genuine reference cases. See docs/DECISIONS.md. This is not Phase 2 or push authorization.

phases.title: Inspect failed optimizations
phases.outcome: Target cutoff to optimized RC values under physical constraints.
phases.gate: Two optimizer baselines run on valid test cases with equal simulation budgets.

tasks.title: Define objective and feasibility
tasks.action: Implement target cutoff/response objective and constraint handling; return infeasible reasons.
tasks.acceptance: No optimization of invalid netlists or unsupported targets; units consistent.

tasks.title: Seeded random and grid baselines
tasks.action: Build deterministic baseline with budgets, E-series optional, call counting and structured output.
tasks.acceptance: Repeat with fixed seed yields identical candidate list and metrics.

tasks.title: SciPy differential evolution
tasks.action: Run bounded differential evolution and compare on same max SPICE calls; cache duplicate points.
tasks.acceptance: Budget cap respected, results exportable and comparable.

tasks.title: Inspect failed optimizations
tasks.action: Review infeasibility and performance failures against expectations; decide ranges.
tasks.acceptance: At least 5 varied cases with human review and no fabricated wins.

phases.title: Audit baseline fairness
phases.outcome: Versioned cases, repeatable multi-seed comparisons and saved evidence.
phases.gate: At least 20 benchmark cases run with logged seeds/configs/results and readable summary.

tasks.title: Benchmark schema and cases
tasks.action: Create 20 curated RC tasks spanning cutoff and feasible bounds; no duplicated disguised cases.
tasks.acceptance: Every case has target, bounds, accepted error and expected feasibility.

tasks.title: Evaluation harness
tasks.action: Run fixed-seed trials with equal call budgets, log runtime, failures, environment and configs.
tasks.acceptance: Re-run yields same numerical results within documented tolerances.

tasks.title: Audit baseline fairness
tasks.action: Audit 5 cases, acceptance logic, runtime measurement and success definitions.
tasks.acceptance: Clear definition of simulation success, numerical success and invalid candidate.

phases.title: Review tolerance assumptions
phases.outcome: Demonstrate robust vs nominal design tradeoffs.
phases.gate: Robustness runs reproduce quantiles and performance comparison with declared tolerance model.

tasks.title: Monte Carlo model
tasks.action: Seeded tolerance sampling, explicit distributions and sampling budget; compute quantiles and pass rate.
tasks.acceptance: Fixed-seed Monte Carlo repeatability; nominal vs tolerance statistics shown separately.

tasks.title: Robust objective experiment
tasks.action: Add tolerance-aware penalty and comparison under matched total simulation budgets.
tasks.acceptance: Report measured tradeoffs without claiming improvement if unsupported.

tasks.title: Review tolerance assumptions
tasks.action: Choose tolerance ranges, correlation assumptions and interpretation limits.
tasks.acceptance: No simulated confidence described as hardware performance guarantee.

phases.title: User acceptance walkthrough
phases.outcome: CLI/API and optional UI make verified results inspectable.
phases.gate: Independent reviewer runs one complete example with plots, raw results and traceable configuration.

tasks.title: CLI and report export
tasks.action: CLI accepts structured spec and produces JSON/CSV/PNG and traceable simulation log.
tasks.acceptance: Reproduce an example from README with no secrets or service account.

tasks.title: Add minimal FastAPI service
tasks.action: Validated endpoint with bounded compute, response schemas and safe temp cleanup.
tasks.acceptance: Integration test response consistent with CLI, no arbitrary netlist execution.

tasks.title: Engineering dashboard (optional)
tasks.action: Minimal plot and comparison view after engine passes gates; keep core package usable without UI.
tasks.acceptance: Shows verified vs unverified candidates and failure reasons.

tasks.title: User acceptance walkthrough
tasks.action: Attempt clean install, complete example and review UX / interpretation.
tasks.acceptance: External reviewer can identify objective, circuit and evidence from output.

phases.title: Approve API trial and spending
phases.outcome: Test whether structured LLM suggestions add measurable value.
phases.gate: If paid key/provider inaccessible, mark experiment deferred and preserve reproducible non-LLM result; no claims without trials.

tasks.title: Provider-neutral proposal interface
tasks.action: Define structured candidate interface with validation, rate/cost caps, mock tests; optional real provider adapter.
tasks.deliverable: LLM proposal plugin isolated from core.
tasks.acceptance: Invalid topology rejected; no required API key for basic design.

tasks.title: Equal-budget agent ablation
tasks.action: Run available LLM proposals vs baselines under stated budgets, track tokens, costs, failures and seeds.
tasks.acceptance: Comparative evidence provided or explicitly marked unrun due to access.

tasks.title: Approve API trial and spending
tasks.action: Review pricing/privacy/terms and set maximum expenditure; do not commit secrets.
tasks.acceptance: No paid traffic without explicit approval.

phases.title: Verify demo and claims
phases.outcome: Documented repo, demo, findings and truthful CV-ready evidence.
phases.gate: Clean setup, tests, reproducible benchmark, demo and research report.

tasks.title: Engineering documentation
tasks.action: README, architecture diagrams, API docs, installation troubleshooting, reproducibility commands and known limits.
tasks.acceptance: Clean-room developer can reproduce at least one supported design.

tasks.title: Technical research report
tasks.action: Write method, baselines, results, confidence limits, failure analysis, threats to validity and next steps.
tasks.acceptance: Every numeric statement derived from stored experiment data; no fabricated results.

tasks.title: Verify demo and claims
tasks.action: Record 60–90s demo and approve accurate CV wording.
tasks.acceptance: Demo shows actual system, not illustrative simulations.

phases.title: Decide constrained PCB research
phases.outcome: Constrained topology extension and KiCad/PCB feasibility research.
phases.gate: Explicit feasibility decision with validated model, export test and no industrial claims.

tasks.title: Component registry and model compatibility
tasks.action: Prototype versioned R/C/L records, SPICE model compatibility flags, licensing metadata and pin mapping.
tasks.deliverable: verified registry schema and 20-model smoke-test report when appropriate.
tasks.acceptance: Compatibility evidence, not claim all PSpice models work.

tasks.title: KiCad export proof of concept
tasks.action: Export one permitted schematic/netlist and inspect resulting editable project; no promised PCB auto-layout.
tasks.acceptance: Schematic pins and netlist connectivity reviewed; errors detectable.

tasks.title: Decide constrained PCB research
tasks.action: Specify board layers, DRC, routing restrictions and when PCB work would be justified.
tasks.acceptance: Scope remains two-layer simple boards, not arbitrary optimal PCB.
